text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation standing outside this glass-walled room, seeing a group of people deeply engaged in discussion. Am I merely an observer, or should I "join" them? Outside, the world is quieter, more detached. In the next moment, I stand among design and research, surrounded by colorful walls and bold letters—R + D. Here, I sense the energy of innovation, but I’m also aware that I am on the edge, reflecting on the contrast between collaboration and solitary contemplation. I feel inspired and thoughtful, yet slightly disconnected from the pulse of group activity.
